section: Laws for women - Dowry Prohibition Act, Domestic Violence Act 2005, POSH Act 2013, Maternity Benefit Amendment

accepted.s: According to the current assessment cited, approximately how many dowry deaths occur in India per day?
accepted.x: The assessment places the incidence at approximately 20 dowry deaths per day.
accepted.tq: Use the precise numerical figure rather than an approximate distractor.

accepted.s: The annual number of dowry deaths referred to in the current assessment is best represented by which of the following?
accepted.x: The assessment refers to more than 6,000 dowry deaths annually.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the annual magnitude from the daily estimate.

accepted.s: Which of the following States are identified as leading in the incidence of dowry deaths?
o: Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh
Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan
Punjab, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand
accepted.x: Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan are identified as the leading States in the cited assessment.
accepted.tq: Test the exact membership of a named group rather than a single State.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the implementation of the POSH framework in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Twenty-six Local Committees have been formed.
2. Ten thousand four hundred and thirty-seven Internal Committees have been formed.
3. Eighty-six out of eighty-eight POSH cases have been resolved.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: Andhra Pradesh has 26 Local Committees, 10,437 Internal Committees, and 86 of 88 POSH cases were resolved.
accepted.tq: Retain the exact committee counts and the resolved-case ratio before selecting the combined option.

accepted.s: With reference to the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act in Andhra Pradesh, which one of the following combinations is correct?
o: 51,581 cases and relief of Rs 9 crore
26 cases and relief of Rs 10,437 crore
88 cases and relief of Rs 86 crore
6,000 cases and relief of Rs 20 crore
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh data refer to 51,581 cases under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act and relief amounting to Rs 9 crore.
accepted.tq: Match the numerical case figure with its corresponding relief amount.

accepted.s: Which one of the following best describes the legal character of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act as highlighted in the current debate?
o: It is a law applicable only to workplace harassment.
It is exclusively a criminal law and provides no civil remedies.
It is exclusively a constitutional remedy.
It is only civil in nature.
accepted.x: The criticism highlighted is that the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act is only civil in nature.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between civil domestic-violence remedies and criminal-law provisions.

accepted.s: The rape conviction rate in 2023, as referred to in the current assessment, was approximately:
accepted.x: The rape conviction rate in 2023 was cited as 22.7%.
accepted.tq: Separate the latest figure from the earlier-period range used as a distractor.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the trend in the rape conviction rate:
1. The rate in 2023 was 22.7%.
2. It was lower than the rate recorded during 2018–2022.
3. The rate during 2018–2022 was in the range of 27–28%.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The 2023 conviction rate was 22.7%, compared with approximately 27–28% during 2018–2022.
accepted.tq: Compare the latest percentage with the earlier range and identify the direction of change.

accepted.s: A film chamber makes submission of an Internal Complaints Committee report compulsory before granting publicity clearance to a film. This measure is most directly associated with which legislation?
o: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
accepted.x: The compulsory Internal Complaints Committee report is linked to compliance under the POSH Act, 2013.
accepted.tq: Identify the governing law from the institutional mechanism involved.

accepted.s: Which of the following has been identified as a reason for the continuing ineffectiveness of anti-dowry laws?
o: Poor enforcement, faulty FIRs and disguising cases as accidents or suicides
Excessive conviction rates and compulsory mediation in every case
Absence of any statutory prohibition of dowry
accepted.x: Poor enforcement, faulty First Information Reports, and presenting dowry-death cases as accidents or suicides are identified as major reasons for ineffectiveness.
accepted.tq: Select the option containing the complete cause-effect chain rather than an absolute claim.

accepted.s: A special court in which place awarded life imprisonment in a dowry-death case dating from 2020?
accepted.x: A special court in Guntur awarded life imprisonment in a dowry-death case from 2020.
accepted.tq: Test the precise location associated with the judicial action.

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Dowry Prohibition Act — mandatory film publicity clearance report
Section 498A — claims of misuse and heavy under-reporting
accepted.x: Mandatory film publicity clearance based on an Internal Complaints Committee report is associated with POSH compliance, not the Dowry Prohibition Act. The other pairs reflect the issues highlighted in the debate.
accepted.tq: Find the mismatched law-mechanism pair by separating subject areas.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the debates surrounding laws concerning women:
1. The Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act involves an overlap between prostitution and trafficking concerns.
2. Section 498A has been associated with both claims of misuse and heavy under-reporting.
3. The debate on Section 498A is limited exclusively to the question of conviction rates.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because the debate includes misuse claims as well as heavy under-reporting, not only conviction rates.
accepted.tq: Reject the extreme word 'exclusively' when the issue has two stated dimensions.

accepted.s: Which of the following sets of data sources and subjects is correctly associated with the Andhra Pradesh angle?
o: APSES and CDI AP SES — PWDVA, POSH committees and Shakti Sadans
LENS and TH — parliamentary constituencies and river basins
ITPA and Section 498A — Internal Complaints Committees and Shakti Sadans
POSH Act and Maternity Benefit Act — dowry-death conviction rates only
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh angle refers to APSES and CDI AP SES data concerning PWDVA, POSH committees and Shakti Sadans.
accepted.tq: Match the named data sources with the subjects covered by the State-level data.
